(()=>{const p=window.pdfProof;if(p.pages.some(x=>x.outside.length))throw Error('Text outside physical page');for(const token of ['HVAC equipment','UNVERIFIED','SHA-256','AHU-1','GR-1','NOT TESTED','unknown','plenum','beam','transition'])if(!p.pages.map(x=>x.text).join(' ').includes(token))throw Error('Missing PDF content: '+token);return {hash:p.pdfSha256,pages:p.pageCount,renderer:p.version,withinPage:true};})()
